description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs, including functions for data projection, grouping, and formatting, as well as index management for the 'llm_costs' collection in a MongoDB database.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB aggregation projection stage that normalizes and extracts relevant fields from the source documents, handling various schema variants and converting data types as needed.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to each document, converting string dates to Date objects when necessary.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects the normalized date as a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format along with other fields for further aggregation.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Aggregates data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens per day.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates data by user, project, and agent, summing total costs and organizing costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level aggregation results, formatting costs and organizing data into objects.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data by user and project, summing project costs and collecting agent data.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level aggregation results, formatting costs and including agent details.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, summing total user costs and collecting project data.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects the final hierarchical structure with user ID, total cost, and nested projects.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function that runs the aggregation pipeline on the 'llm_costs' collection and formats the results with currency and credits conversion.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the 'llm_costs' collection to optimize query performance.
